decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core catalog the firm can understand and market it well, but a 2018 schlager compilation CD is likely to have limited back-catalog momentum by 2022 and is therefore more likely to be discontinued.
Because this illustrated release series builds directly on the firm's curation and label capabilities and offers scope to learn across several models, absorptive capacity argues for continuing it.
A jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's established reissue know-how and collector audience closely, so the firm is likely to retain it unless title-specific demand proves weak.
Although a multi-disc box set is close to the firm's specialist offer, it is inventory-heavy and often edition-like, so after its 2019 launch it is somewhat more likely to be taken off the market.

This compilation CD appears less strategically important because it was only mentioned rather than given its own page, and as a less differentiated adjacent product it is the most likely to be discontinued.
